episodes.synopsis: With the appearance of otherworldly oni, headed by the massively powerful Kishin, humanity has been forced to serve their new demonic masters. After 150 years of oni rule, the only force left to fight for human freedom are bands of Bushi. This is the story of two young men and their dream of forming the strongest Bushi band!
episodes.title: Musashi & Kojiro

episodes.synopsis: Musashi and Kojiro try to tackle the powerful Kishin that has appeared, but will the two of them really be able to stand up to the class of oni that has dominated Hinomoto for over a hundred years?
episodes.title: Bushi's Pride

episodes.synopsis: With the arrival of the Takeda Bushi band, Musashi is desperate to defeat the Kishin before they can.
episodes.title: The Outside World

episodes.synopsis: Musashi and Kojiro's journey runs immediately into trouble when a mysterious girl steals their vehicle.
episodes.title: The Kosameda Band

episodes.synopsis: Musashi and Kojiro are forced to find a way to escape the Kosameda Castle prison, while Tsumugi is trapped between her desire to protect her friends and the commands of her domineering father.
episodes.title: Choosing Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Tsumugi struggles with deciding what to do next, and Musashi encounters a mysterious, and unhinged, Bushi in black.
episodes.title: Getting Stronger

episodes.synopsis: Musashi and Kojiro are out to obtain the Kitetsu Blades they'll need to fight oni, but a mysterious ritual involving the mystical swords might prove to be an unexpected hurdle.
episodes.title: You Can't Survive Underwater

episodes.synopsis: Shiro offers to help Musashi overcome his difficulties with Kitetsu Blades and get stronger, but can he be trusted?
episodes.title: The Obsidian Goddess

episodes.synopsis: As Shiro preys on the other Bushi who have gathered to hunt a Kishin, Musashi has to find a way to escape the lava pit and help his friends.
episodes.title: A Bushi's Way of Life

episodes.synopsis: Musashi, Kojiro, and Tsugumi face off against Nanao and Shiro, and their only hope for victory might be the mysterious entity inside of Musashi.
episodes.title: The Goddess's Power

episodes.synopsis: The Obsidian Goddess tells Musashi that she will be going back to sleep inside of him and no matter what foes he faces, he must not die. Because he is her vessel and because Jisai died before they were able to finish what they started. Musashi wonders what that has to do with Jisai, but the Goddess doesn't have time to explain and decides to show Musashi how she fights in the material world.
episodes.title: What's in a Katana

episodes.synopsis: Leaving for new adventures, the shock trio is already lost in the forest. During a confrontation against an oni, Musashi narrowly saves a young girl, whose role within the bushi is far from trivial...
episodes.title: Where This Road Leads
